articles.title: Nagaland targets 50% expansion in tobacco-free village coverage
articles.summary: (Photo Courtesy: NHM, Mon) Tobacco-Free Youth Campaign launched across State Kohima, October 28 (MExN): Nagaland has launched the Tobacco-Free Youth Campaign (TFYC) 4. 0 across all the state, targeting a 50% increase in Tobacco-Free Village coverage and institutional compliance, a 20% increase in tobacco-control enforcement activities, and engagement of 30% of universities and colleges in the state.
